import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 煞气查看
 * 指令：/煞气
 *
 * 展示当前煞气值、称号、是否在杀神榜、消除途径
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/shaQi/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid });

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '煞气',
        content: md,
        header: [
          { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
          { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
        ],
        footer: [
          { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
          { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
          { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
          { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
          { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const info = result.data;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(`当前煞气：${info.shaQi}`);
  md.addNewline();

  if (info.onKillGodList) {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`⚠️ 你已上杀神榜（煞气≥${info.killGodThreshold}）`);
    md.addNewline();
  }

  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('消除途径：');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`· 每日自然衰减 -${info.dailyDecayAmount}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`· 金盆：消耗 1 个金盆，减少 ${info.jinpenReduceAmount} 点煞气`);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '煞气',
      header: [
        { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
        { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
      ],
      footer: [
        { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
        { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
        { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
        { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
        { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
      ],
      content: md
    })
  );
});
